title: Scaled L^p hypothesis: finiteness and real form on sub-balls
statement: Let n and l be natural numbers and p real with n < p. Let mu be a measure on R^(n+l), H : R^(n+l) -> R^(n+l), y in R^(n+l), and R, Lambda, t real with R > 0, Lambda > 0 and t <= R. Write kappa := (p - n)/(4p) and, for real s, Q_s := the lower (extended) integral over the closed ball closedBall y s of |H|^p dmu, a value in [0, infinity]. Assume (ofReal(R^(p-n)) * Q_R)^(1/p) <= ofReal(kappa Lambda) in [0, infinity]. Then Q_t < infinity and (Q_t.toReal)^(1/p) <= kappa Lambda R^(n/p - 1), with real powers.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (p : ℝ), (n : ℝ) < p → ∀ (μ : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (H : Amb n ℓ → Amb n ℓ) (y : Amb n ℓ) (R Λ t : ℝ), 0 < R → 0 < Λ → t ≤ R → (ENNReal.ofReal (R ^ (p - n)) * ∫⁻ x in closedBall y R, ‖H x‖ₑ ^ p ∂μ) ^ (1 / p) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((p - n) / (4 * p) * Λ) → ∫⁻ x in closedBall y t, ‖H x‖ₑ ^ p ∂μ < ⊤ ∧ (∫⁻ x in closedBall y t, ‖H x‖ₑ ^ p ∂μ).toReal ^ (1 / p) ≤ (p - n) / (4 * p) * Λ * R ^ ((n : ℝ) / p - 1)
